_doc: Example launch.json for a single personal Mac. Copied to ~/.claude/robowright/launch.json beside profile.md. test_session_state.py runs its unit block through the real launcher. Patterns are POSIX ERE as bash's [[ =~ ]] reads them; group_regex captures the project name, which ends at the first three-digit segment. accounting_root is optional; without it the accounting ledger goes in accounting/ beside sessions_root. repos lists the main clones the Owner-side tools may run git in; a project's robowright.json naming any other is refused, and with no repos nothing is trusted. launch is paste: the launcher prints the claude --bg line for the Owner to run; auto, under which the launcher runs it, is the opt-in (SECURITY.md).
